kept.q:
From the options lettered A to D, choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the word in capitals.
CAT
kept.explanation: The word in capitals, CAT, has the short vowel sound /æ/ as in 'bag'. BACK also has /æ/. CAKE and CARE have the diphthong /eɪ/ and /eə/, while CAR has the long vowel /ɑː/.
kept.pidgin: The word for capitals, CAT, get the short sound /æ/ like for 'bag'. BACK get the same /æ/ sound. CAKE and CARE get different diphthong sounds, CAR get long /ɑː/ sound.

kept.q:
From the options lettered A to D, choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the word in capitals.
FEAST
kept.explanation: FEAST has the long vowel sound /i:/. BEACH also has /i:/. BREAD has /e/, GREAT has /eɪ/, and BEAR has /eə/.
kept.pidgin: FEAST get long /i:/ sound. BEACH too get /i:/. BREAD get /e/, GREAT get /eɪ/, BEAR get /eə/, na why dem no match.

kept.q:
From the options lettered A to D, choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the word in capitals.
SUIT
kept.explanation: SUIT is pronounced with the long vowel /u:/ as in 'moon'. BOOT shares this sound. FOOT has the short /ʊ/, OUT has the diphthong /aʊ/, and BUT has /ʌ/.
kept.pidgin: SUIT get long /u:/ sound like for 'moon'. BOOT get the same one. FOOT na short /ʊ/, OUT na /aʊ/, BUT na /ʌ/, so dem no match.

kept.q: In each of the words PEAK, SPEAK, LEAK and BREAK, the vowel sound is the same except in one word. From the options lettered A to D, identify the word with the different vowel sound.
kept.explanation: PEAK, SPEAK and LEAK all have the long vowel /i:/. BREAK is pronounced with the diphthong /eɪ/, making it the odd one out, even though it looks spelt like the others.
kept.pidgin: PEAK, SPEAK and LEAK all get /i:/ sound. BREAK na /eɪ/ sound, e be the different one even though e resemble the others for spelling.

kept.q: In each of the words COW, HOW, NOW and BOY, the vowel sound is the same except in one word. From the options lettered A to D, identify the word with the different vowel sound.
kept.explanation: COW, HOW and NOW all contain the diphthong /aʊ/. BOY contains a different diphthong, /ɔɪ/, so it does not share the same vowel sound as the other three.
kept.pidgin: COW, HOW and NOW all get /aʊ/ sound. BOY get different diphthong /ɔɪ/, so e no match the other three.

kept.q:
From the options lettered A to D, choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the word in capitals.
PUT
kept.explanation: PUT is pronounced with the short vowel /ʊ/ as in 'book'. PUSH has the same /ʊ/ sound. PUB and PUN have /ʌ/, while PURE has a different glide sound /jʊə/.
kept.pidgin: PUT get short /ʊ/ sound like for 'book'. PUSH get the same /ʊ/. PUB and PUN na /ʌ/, PURE na different /jʊə/ sound.

kept.q:
From the options lettered A to D, choose the word that has the same final vowel sound as the word in capitals.
TEACHER
kept.explanation: In Received Pronunciation, TEACHER ends with the unstressed schwa sound /ə/. MIRROR also ends with /ə/. CHAIR, HAIR and CARE all end with the diphthong /eə/, which is a different sound.
kept.pidgin: For correct British pronunciation, TEACHER dey end with weak schwa sound /ə/. MIRROR too dey end with /ə/. CHAIR, HAIR and CARE dey end with /eə/ sound, na different one.
